lines: My browser survival game stranded-horizons is the one project still on Vercel auto-deploys, a lightweight vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript wave survival game on HTML5 Canvas with WASD and mouse aim, coin-funded speed and damage upgrades and a localStorage highscore, with no backend and no build step: https://github.com/drosemann/stranded-horizons
On the client side I use Windows, with a nod to the games industry, and I plan to switch to Linux as soon as anticheat support gets better.
My focus is on cybersecurity, AI, cloud and virtualization, and automation with Python.

-For that Python side I built aktienwerk, which turns SEC filings and stock prices for 100 US companies into plain explanations with only the standard library and SQLite: https://github.com/drosemann/aktienwerk

+For that Python side I built aktienwerk, which turns SEC EDGAR filings, stock prices and optional earnings-call transcripts for 100 US companies into plain German explanations with only the standard library and SQLite, served as server-rendered pages and a JSON API, with optional local Ollama explanations and no investment advice: https://github.com/drosemann/aktienwerk
My hosting path went from Aternos to Ploudos to Minehub, which later closed.
After that it went through DeinServerHost, Strato, Host-Unlimited, LuxVPS and Mine-Hoster.
I cancelled ST-Hosting after one month because their LXC setup didn't meet my expectations, and HT-Hosting went insolvent, which taught me to migrate under time pressure.
